feature_semantics.shift_sigma: signed displacement of the window mean in baseline standard-deviation units
feature_semantics.slope_sigma_h: signed local OLS trend in baseline standard deviations per hour
feature_semantics.residual_std_ratio: ratio of residual standard deviations after linear detrending
feature_semantics.diff_std_ratio: ratio of standard deviations of first differences; sample-to-sample variation
feature_semantics.raw_std_ratio: descriptive ratio of raw standard deviations; overall dispersion only

phase_partition.intermediate: all windows between initial and late phases

global_persistence.policy: do not infer from a two-window episode alone; always report active fraction, sign consistency, and late-regime activity
global_persistence.strict_level_label: active in every window, one sign throughout, and active in the late regime
global_persistence.strict_drift_label: slope active in every window with one sign, window means evolving coherently in that direction, and active in the late regime
global_persistence.strict_variability_label: active in every window and active in the late regime

temporal_logic.transient: dynamic feature active initially, lower later, and inactive in the late regime while a possible level displacement can remain
